title: Add per-page CU cost, confidence, and output review metrics
description: Implement the approved hybrid CU accounting model: retain chunked CU calls, allocate contextualization and LLM costs equally among pages in each chunk, persist reconcilable page metrics with confidence/output provenance, and display them in the document detail review experience.
design: Use exact CU meter cost where usage supports page-tier counts; allocate shared contextualization and LLM costs evenly per page in the CU chunk. Persist additive document properties without changing existing document output contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Per-page metrics reconcile to document CU costs; detail UI surfaces per-page cost breakdown, confidence, and output provenance; focused tests and frontend build pass.
close_reason: Implemented and validated per-page CU net/list costs, confidence, output provenance, API compatibility, and complete lightweight Explore loading.

title: Meter-accurate CU cost tracking: capture usage tiers + price per pricing model
description: ARGUS prices Content Understanding as a flat per-page cost (_cu_page_price) and discards the CU usage object. Per the CU pricing model, cost = content extraction (tiered minimal/basic/standard pages) + contextualization tokens + LLM input/output tokens (billed on Foundry deployment). Implement: capture CU response usage object (documentPagesMinimal/Basic/Standard, contextualizationToken, tokens) + log meter tier; add CU meter pricing to pricing_fallback.json + resolver; CostTracker.record_cu_usage(); wire into blob_processing.py replacing flat per-page; persist meter breakdown to document properties; tests.
close_reason: Meter-accurate CU cost tracking shipped + validated live: usage captured, content_understanding + content_understanding_llm stages priced, UI CU-level badge, 21 tests pass.

title: SSE live UI updates: Cosmos change-feed -> EventSource (no polling)
notes: Deployed + validated E2E. Backend rev ca-argus--0000017 (image sse-fix-20260630162313). Live document events stream the full lifecycle (queued -> ocr_completed -> stage upserts -> processing_completed). NOTE: azure-cosmos 4.9.0 has a change-feed bug -- ChangeFeedStartFromPointInTime.to_dict serializes start_time as MILLISECONDS but from_json deserializes via datetime.fromtimestamp() (SECONDS), corrupting internal state into 'year 58466 out of range' on every poll. Fix: prime the poller with the 'Now' string literal instead of a datetime object (different start-from subclass, unaffected by the bug).

title: PaddleOCR cost-saving pre-gate experiment
description: Self-hosted PaddleOCR in Azure Container Apps as a CHEAP quality pre-gate BEFORE Document Intelligence/CU. Low-quality scans short-circuit (skip paid DI/CU), get flagged, route to review. Experiment goal: does Paddle catch bad scans (bad.png) with low FP on real claims, and estimate $ saved.
design: Decisions: separate INTERNAL container app ca-argus-paddleocr (FastAPI + PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 mobile English, CPU, scale-to-zero 0-3, 2vCPU/4Gi). Backend calls via PADDLE_OCR_URL internal ingress. Mode=block (skip DI/CU on bad). DI word-confidence gate kept as BACKSTOP. Enablement=opt-in (ENABLE_PADDLE_PREGATE default false, per-dataset override). Signal: per-line rec_score -> {mean,frac_low,min}; verdict bad if mean<PADDLE_CONFIDENCE_MEAN_MIN(0.80) or frac_low>PADDLE_CONFIDENCE_LOW_FRAC_MAX(0.25), low=score<PADDLE_CONFIDENCE_WORD_MIN(0.70). Pre-gate inserts in blob_processing.process_blob after file_paths (~line 520) before extraction_backend branch.

title: agent_framework API: Role is NewType(str), use string role literals
description: In agent-framework 0.0.0, Role imported from agent_framework is typing.NewType('Role', str), NOT an enum. Message(role, contents) takes a RoleLiteral string: 'system'|'user'|'assistant'|'tool'. Do NOT use Role.USER/.ASSISTANT. Content.from_text()/from_uri() build parts; ChatOptions is a dict accepting response_format/seed/temperature/max_tokens. FoundryChatClient(project_endpoint=,model=,credential=).

title: Python tooling is uv (Python 3.13); verified build/test commands
description: Dependencies live in src/containerapp/pyproject.toml + uv.lock (no requirements.txt). Setup: 'uv sync' in src/containerapp. Tests MUST run from repo root: 'uv run --project src/containerapp pytest src/evaluators/tests' (the tests use 'from src.evaluators...' which only resolves as a namespace package from repo root). Docker: multi-stage python:3.13-slim using 'uv sync --frozen'. CI uses astral-sh/setup-uv@v5.

title: LLM orchestration goes through ai_ocr/agents (Microsoft Agent Framework)
description: All LLM calls must use the shared agents layer (run_chat / run_chat_sync) in src/containerapp/ai_ocr/agents/, never openai.AzureOpenAI directly. Primary client is FoundryChatClient (Azure AI Foundry project endpoint AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT); falls back to OpenAIChatClient when no project endpoint is set. Auth is passwordless (DefaultAzureCredential / managed identity). client.py bridges async Agent Framework to sync worker threads via a persistent background event loop.
